claims.assertion: Athena says volcanoes vent planetary pressure and nearby earthquakes can raise magma pressure, contributing to eruptions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena describes Temmer as geologically stable, with no active volcanoes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena suspects Popocatépetl’s eruption was triggered or enhanced artificially, citing shallow pressurized magma, surface electromagnetism, and explosives.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presents circumstantial indicators, not confirmation.

claims.assertion: Athena reports Reptilians were seen posing as military near evacuated villages by Popocatépetl.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena, relaying reports)
claims.qualifiers: She says their origin is unknown.
